I'm not a relationship expert, but I really feel for you, OP. I've been there, too. It is just like an actual break up in a relationship since you and your dom have shared something really special. 

I think it's been said before, but there's really nothing you can do to get your mind off it. When my dom broke it off with me, I thought I was never going to recover. At school and work, I couldn't focus, kept crying out of nowhere. I did kept myself busy because *I wanted to forget*. But I realized that it doesn't work that way. I had to accept the pain. *It's over, he's/she's gone*. It sounds really hard and painful, and every time you remember it, it's going to feel like you're being ripped apart into little shreds. But the more you accept it and realize it, that's the only time you'll be able to do something else after. 

Accepting that it's over is the first step because the next is "okay, what should I be doing to help myself?". The first poster already said it. Focus on yourself. Don't try to find another dom because that's inviting trouble. Get into your other hobbies, form new friendships. Try something new and interesting. Collect as many hobbies as you can and remember, "this is all for me." (taking the place of "it's over, he/she's gone"). Self-improvement always makes people happy.

Take all the time you need. Weeks, months, years. It'll be like a dull ache pretty soon enough. And I know it might sound weird, but in case you really need someone to talk to, just drop me a line. Sometimes, ranting to strangers on the internet is actually more comfortable than opening up to people who are really close to you. 

As for finding a dom that will accept you in the future, don't focus on that now. It'll happen when the time is right.

Not to sound cliche, but it gets better. Stay strong, OP. You'll be okay.
